messages.author: a4a07587f2b97425
messages.subject: phylomophospace input
parts:
Hi everyone!

I´m trying to plot the phylomorphospace in geomorph, but I do not understand well how to construct the coords matrix for it.
I have 20 species, I did a procrustes analyses for each species (procrustes1<–gpagen(species1) and then I extracted the consensus of each analyses (procrustes1$consensus), but I can merge all the consensus files into a single one suitable for the plotGMphylomorphospace function.

Then, I tried exporting the each consensus to an .cvs file and construct in excel a file with the 20 consensus, but I cannot organize them correctly. When I read the file into R it is a mess.

Is there a way to merge all the consensus in to a single for the plotGMphylomorphospace function? or How can I organize an excel file suitable for the function?

Thank you in advance
 
Karen López

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] phylomophospace input
parts:
Karen,

 

One should perform GPA on all specimens combined, not species by species. Then, one can obtain the species means, and put these into a new object for the phylomorphospace function.

 

Obtaining species means is conveniently done using ‘coords.subet’ and then a lapply loop with ‘mshape’.  The example in the help file of that function will show you how.

 

Best,


Dean

 

Dr. Dean C. Adams

Director of Graduate Education, EEB Program

Professor

Department of Ecology, Evolution, and Organismal Biology

Iowa State University

Dear Dean, 

Thanks for your response, that firstly worked, but now I have another error when I try to execute the plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace function, here is my code

tpsfile_CE <- readland.tps("Cabezas_Eupomphini.tps", specID="ID")

gpaCEheads <- gpagen(tpsfile_CE, curves=slider1)


Spec <- read.table("Spec.txt", header=TRUE)

gdfCEheads <- geomorph.data.frame(gpaCEheads, species=Spec)

new.coords <- coords.subset(A=gdfCEheads$coords, group=gdfCEheads$species)


meanbygroups <- lapply(new.coords, shape)


phy <- read.nexus("~/Documents/Mario_Digi/tree3.tre")

plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace(phy, meanbygroups)


And here is the error:

plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace(phy, meanbygroups)
Error in plotGMPhyloMorphoSpace(phy, meanbygroups) : 
  object "x" not found 

But, I previously created an object called meanbygroups, so the object really exists.
I think it is related with how "meanbygroups" is organized, cause there is no a subset who includes all the coordinates as in a regular gpagen object  ($coords)
I have already tried to convert "meanly groups in a geomorphic.data.frame, but still not working

Any help?

Thank you in advance 
Karen
